INFERNO_GENERATOR_11 }} An '''Inferno Minion''' is a {{Skill|Combat}} [[Minion]] that spawns {{MobSprite|Infernal (Mob)|alt=Infernals (Mob)}} and collects {{Item|Crude Gabagool}}. '''Inferno Minion''' recipes are unlocked at {{Coll|Blaze Slayer LVL 3}}. The minion is tradeable and may be used without {{Coll|Blaze Slayer LVL 3}}, but it cannot be crafted or upgraded without meeting the slayer requirement. An '''Inferno Minion''' is normally extremely slow. However its speed can be boosted by its ability [[#Abilities|{{AN|Rising Celsius}}]] (up to {{Green|180%}}) and {{Item|Inferno Minion Fuel}} ({{Green|10x}}, {{Green|15x}}, or {{Green|20x}}) to around the average of other minions. {{Item|Inferno Minion Fuel}} also lets the minion have other drops. == Usage == === Drops === {{Minion Drops Table}} ==== Inferno Minion Fuel ==== {{Main|Inferno Minion Fuel}} The {{Item|Crude Gabagool}} base drop of an '''Inferno Minion''' can be replaced by using {{Item|Inferno Minion Fuel}}. The [[Distillates|Distillate]] used in crafting the {{Item|Inferno Minion Fuel}} determines what item the '''Inferno Minion''' will specialise in creating, either {{Item|Magma Cream}}, {{Item|Blaze Rod}}, {{Item|Nether Wart}}, {{Item|Glowstone Dust}}, or {{Item|Crude Gabagool}}. The distillate's output will replace the normal output 80% of time the minion makes a harvest. Giving fuel created with {{Item|Hypergolic Gabagool}} to an '''Inferno Minion''' lets it very rarely produce special items ({{Item|Chili Pepper}}, {{Item|Inferno Vertex}}, {{Item|Inferno Apex}}, {{Item|Reaper Pepper}}, {{Item|Gabagool the Fish}}). Applying {{Item|Capsaicin Eyedrops}} to the minion will increase the chance of these rare items by {{Green|30%}} for 24 hours. An '''Inferno Minion X''' and an '''Inferno Minion XI''' will create an additional {{Item|Inferno Apex}} upon creating one, because of their [[#Abilities|{{AN|Apex Minion}}]] ability. === Stats === {{MinionStatsTable}} ==== Abilities ==== {| class="wikitable" ! Description |- | {{AN|Rising Celsius}} || class="ct" | I–XI || Each '''Inferno Minion''' increases the speed of ALL '''Inferno Minions''' by {{Green|18%}}, up to {{Green|180%}}. |- | {{AN|Apex Minion}} || class="ct" | X, XI || When creating an {{Item|Inferno Apex}}, create 2. |} === Layouts === ==== Ideal Layout ==== {{Minion ideal layout|minion=Inferno Minion|ideal=Air (minion)|border=Oak Fence}} === Minion Modifiers === {{Minion Modifiers List|combat}} == Obtaining == Note: The price for Amalgamated Crimsonite is typically much more expensive when buying items that have only been compacted once, and prices should be checked as to whether it is cheaper to use Amalgamated Crimsonite's first recipe or the second recipe. {{MinionRecipesTable}} == Tips == * As a budget setup, a player can use 9 tier I-II '''Inferno Minions''' to boost the one of highest tier. == Bugs == * The speed multipliers from {{Item|Inferno Minion Fuel}}s are applied along with the other speed buffs to the base action time as follows:\frac{\text{baseActionTime}}{(1 + \text{speedBuffs}) * (1 + \text{InfernoMinionFuelMultiplier})}. This extra 1+ in front of the Inferno Minion Fuels multiplier causes the effective multipliers to be {{Green|11x}}, {{Green|16x}}, and {{Green|21x}}. == Trivia == * '''Inferno Minion''' is the slowest minion type in Normal mode. * '''Inferno Minion''' is the only minion type: **That has an ability. **That requires itself to be crafted twice, rather than once; or itself and another minion. **That cannot be quickcrafted into the next tier when placed. *In versions before [[Changelog/2023/October 4|SkyBlock 0.19.5]], the {{AN|Apex Minion}} ability was bugged and only created the two {{Item|Inferno Apex}} if the {{Zone|Private Island}} is loaded (for example if the player is AFK). If not, then it would've generated only one. It was theorized that while offline, the minion attempted to stack the two together, which is considered invalid, thus the second is deleted to become a single item. * '''Inferno Minion''' has the lowest slayer level requirement of all slayer specific minion types. * Without using {{Item|Inferno Minion Fuel}}s created with {{Item|Hypergolic Gabagool}}, players can only get to tier VIII of '''Inferno Minion''' without buying {{Item|Inferno Vertex|text=Inferno Vertices}} from other players. * The production rate of {{Item|Inferno Vertex|text=Inferno Vertices}} was designed to be "a couple Inferno Vertices a day" with a "maxed" setup.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EcoYLGtXGB4&t=210 * It used to be a common belief that the rare drops of {{Rarity|L}} [[Inferno Minion Fuel]] rolled once per item, rather than once per harvest, this has been proven false. This resulted in the [[Distillates|Nether Wart Distillate]] being more popular at the time. * {{Rarity|L}} [[Inferno Minion Fuel]]s can be stacked inside an '''Inferno Minion''' despite not normally being stackable, and will have the fuel time match the amount stacked. * Before the minion backend update on April 9, 2025, only one {{Item|Hypergolic Ionized Ceramics}} would appear after all the fuel was depleted, even if multiple were inserted. * Contrary to a common belief, while the {{Zone|Private Island}} is not loaded, all drops (including the rare drops) from an '''Inferno Minion''' are affected by {{NPCSprite|Derpy}}'s {{AN|TURBO MINIONS!!!}} ability. ** This common belief likely originated from a time altering bug of {{AN|TURBO MINIONS!!!}} (see [[Derpy#Bugs]]). == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 21|link=none|[[File:Inferno Minion I.png|26px]] Added '''Inferno Minion'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Inferno Minion I.png|26px]] Added '''Inferno Minion'''.}} {{History|2022/August 5|'''Inferno Minions''' now produce [[Chili Pepper]]s.|Increased the drop chances of [[Inferno Vertex|Inferno Vertices]], [[Inferno Apex]]es, [[Reaper Pepper]]s, and [[Gabagool the Fish]] by {{Green|10%}}.|Increased {{AN|Rising Celsius}} speed boost from {{Green|6%}} per minion to {{Green|18%}} per minion up to 10 minions.}} {{History|0.19.5|Increased the speed of '''Inferno Minions''' by about {{Green|9%}}.|Increased the drop chances of [[Inferno Vertex]] {{Green|2.8x}}, [[Inferno Apex]] by {{Green|20%}}, and [[Chili Pepper]] by {{Green|15%}}.}} }} == References == == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Blaze}} {{Nav/Minions}} [[Category:Slayer Minions]]
